title: General Statutes of Connecticut, Title 31 (Labor), Chapter 574 — Connecticut Retirement Security Authority. Connecticut Retirement Security Exchange
source_id: Conn. Gen. Stat. ch. 574, §§ 31-416 to 31-429 (§§ 31-410 to 31-415 superseded)
verified_how: fetched the register chapter page: heading 'CHAPTER 574 CONNECTICUT RETIREMENT SECURITY AUTHORITY. CONNECTICUT RETIREMENT SECURITY EXCHANGE'; live sections Sec. 31-416 (Definitions) through Sec. 31-427 are listed individually, while Secs. 31-410 to 31-415 appear only as a collapsed superseded block.
notes: The statutory basis of MyCTSavings, the state-facilitated auto-IRA for private-sector workers whose employers offer no plan. State employees' pensions are separately governed by Chapter 66, State Employees Retirement Act (https://www.cga.ct.gov/current/pub/chap_066.htm), fetched and confirmed in force. Old-age, survivors and disability insurance itself is federal (42 U.S.C. ch. 7).
